about_the_game:
The Original Soundtrack of MASH VP! Re:VISION is here!
Three albums in one set:

  • VOCAL RE:BUiLD – focusing on vocal tracks

  • HARD RE:BUiLD – featuring hard-hitting tracks

  • CINEMA RE:BUiLD – highlighting cinematic tracks

Plus plenty of exclusive tracks available only in COMPLETE RE:BUiLD!
Includes previously unreleased mashups and system BGMs!

※This soundtrack contains the same tracks as

MASH VP! Re:VISION OST – VOCAL RE:BUiLD,

MASH VP! Re:VISION OST – HARD RE:BUiLD, and

MASH VP! Re:VISION OST – CINEMA RE:BUiLD,

which are sold separately. Please be aware that purchasing both will result in duplicate purchases.
